_comment: Repository ruleset for the default branch (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules), matched by name: the script updates the live 'Protect main' ruleset in place (PUT) or creates it (POST).

Required checks: exactly 'CI / Gate' (caller job CI in pull-request-ci.yml, main-ci.yml and release.yml -> reusable job Gate in ci.yml) and 'PR policy' (pr-policy.yml), both pinned to the GitHub Actions app (integration_id 15368) so no other app can satisfy them (shared-contracts 1.2). strict_required_status_checks_policy stays false: without a merge queue it would force a rebase and a full Windows run for every merge.

Pull requests: squash only (the subject on main is the PR title the PR policy verified), no required approval and no required code-owner review (single active maintainer; CODEOWNERS is informational), stale approvals dismissed. No bypass actor: the maintainer goes through the same checks.

Apply the required checks only after main is green and PR policy has reported at least once, otherwise every pull request is blocked: run Set-RepositorySettings.ps1 with -SkipRequiredChecks before that.
name: Protect main
